ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: ParkLog uses the camera to photograph the cars you spot.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ParkLog accesses your photos so you can pick the picture of a car.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ParkLog saves a copy of the photos you take to your gallery.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ParkLog uses your location to pin on the map where you spotted each car.
